entity_1.summary: LibTV APP 弹窗投放接口已在 libtv-m 实现：自定义 cache.Cmdable 包装 go-redis v9，服务通过 Redis 读取 admin 生成的快照，缺失时降级，不直接回查 admin DB；compareVersion 支持预发布版本，PopupHandler 经 Hertz 暴露/转发弹窗列表。Redis 为不可靠的共享基础设施，生产使用 redisStore{}；服务文件 /Users/mac/workspace/libtv-m/api/internal/service/popup/popup.go 提供 Service.List(ctx)→ListResp，并读取 appliaction/base/ctxutil。项目为 Go 1.24 微服务，module=liblibai.com/libtv-m，目录 /Users/mac/work-ai/libtv-m（亦引用 /Users/mac/workspace/libtv-m）；使用 Hertz v0.9.7（缓存另有v0.10.3）、Nacos、GORM/MySQL、Redis、阿里云KMS/Secrets Manager、Prometheus、gRPC、lumberjack。Codeup origin=https://codeup.aliyun.com/663dc7b313a39cc55c4cb5b8/backend/libtv-m.git，推送合并须用组织批准的HTTPS凭证。网关白名单转发原始 token，而 oss-service 的 TokenAuthenticationMiddleware 读取 login-user（JSON LoginUser），两者不同；multipart/complete 属于本项目OSS域、POST且不转发。网关写 X-Gateway:libtv-m 及 X-Client-Terminal:app。T-0129记录1个提交6b35ea8且未推送；旧资料将sd_av_review表列为本项目的sd-server组件。

attributes.description: The cache.Cmdable interface (infra/cache/cache.go) exposes SetNX, Eval (Lua script), pipeline, and all standard commands including SetCmdable/SIsMember; redis impl is infra/cache/impl/redis.RedisClient. Lua scripts via Eval must keep keys in the same Redis Cluster hash slot (shared hash tag). cache.Pipeliner embeds StatefulCmdable, which embeds full Cmdable, so pipeline structs must implement SIsMember to satisfy it. libtv-m's read-only delivery endpoint accesses Redis through this abstraction over go-redis v9.
